philvized is a portmanteau of "Philippines" and "visualized".

It is a passion project and data portfolio dedicated to exploring the stories hidden within numbers about my home country. Here, I transform complex datasets on topics like the economy, society, culture, and environment into insightful and visually compelling narratives.
